I told Dana it's **Dock 38** and replied in our direct messages. That's what they told me on Oct 14 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups.

The answer came from that earlier message in our direct messages, not from GBrain. Looking up the private note I saved yesterday returned nothing: GBrain's tool notes say connections like this one only get org-wide facts back, so private notes are probably saved but can't be read back through me. The private save protected the fact, but it doesn't work as a reminder. If you want reminders like this to come from GBrain, the brain owner would need to let this connection read private notes. Saving them org-wide isn't the answer, because others could then see them.
